split_policy.primary_axis: lowering fixture role before fixture path convenience, diagnostic sidecar, conformance manifest row, report pointer, runtime-dispatch symbol, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: lowering positives are hand-authored tests/native/lowering fixtures with fixture_kind=positive, canonical_behavior_source=true, and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.strict_error_rule: runtime-dispatch link failures and removed fallback flags are strict-error or canonical rejection evidence; they are not positive lowering support
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, lowering conformance manifests, report pointers, and metadata field names are provenance unless tied to a lowering fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, generated-only, report-only, and migration-only lowering rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no parser, sema, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior contracts
